scope: Registered parent projectile creation, route/fallback fees and damage, alternate input, fan geometry, shared cooldown, owner-hit child creation and nonrecursive child callbacks, invalid requests and owner death. Packet dispatch and partial-spawn rollback use mocked engine boundaries.
limitations: Hit callbacks are invoked directly; no full combat frames, graphical input/layout, real network peers, late join or damage/energy balance acceptance. Existing split projectile assets and behavior are reused.
